name: ntdrive
title_zh: 开机、快照、连 kd.exe 调内核的 VMware
tagline_zh: 蓝屏了不用手忙脚乱翻 WinDbg 配置：它替你开机、打快照、把 kd.exe 挂上串口或 KDNET。
tagline_en: Boot, snapshot, and attach kd.exe over serial or KDNET, plus a real SSH shell inside the guest — reproduce a BSOD.
desc_en: Drive a VMware Workstation Windows guest through the ntdrive MCP tools - power, snapshots, kernel debugging with kd.exe over a serial pipe or KDNET, and a real-time SSH terminal. Use when asked to boot, snapshot, revert, debug a driver, analyze a BSOD, or run commands inside a VM.
why_zh: 把电源、快照、内核调试通道、SSH 四件事收进同一套 MCP 工具，调试前先打快照。
why_en: Power, snapshots, kernel debug transport, and SSH live behind one MCP toolset, so you snapshot before debugging and revert.
limit_zh: 只驱动本机已装好的 VMware Workstation 和现成 Windows 客户机，不负责建虚拟机、装系统。
limit_en: Needs local VMware Workstation and an existing Windows guest; it won't create VMs or install OSes. Debugging requires the guest already in debug.
title_en: VMware guest copilot: boot, snapshot, attach kd.exe
